name: Creamy "Caesar" Chickpea Toasts with Romaine & Grape Salad
instructions: Divide dressing between one medium and one large bowl. (Set large bowl aside for the romaine salad.)
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Add to the medium bowl with the dressing along with salt and pepper. Using a fork or potato masher, roughly mash chickpeas until semi-smooth. Set aside.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the bread.)
Wash, dry, and halve grapes. Add to the large bowl with the dressing.
Wash, dry, and chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl, toss to combine the salad, and set aside.
Arrange bread on a large baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
Divide toast between plates and top with chickpea salad. Serve with romaine salad on the side and enjoy!
author: Mealime
